meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次动手开发前都想先把计划想清楚
copy.tagline_en: Map out an actionable work plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear plan ready before touching code

howto.what: 启用后，Claude 成为规划顾问：先只读探索代码库、理清需求，只在探索解决不了时提问；经你明确批准后，写一份决策完整、执行者无需再问的工作计划并存到 .omo/ 目录。它不会直接写产品代码。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求编码前先做计划时触发，例如说'ulw-plan'、'做个计划'、'先规划再写代码'等；它不会自行激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给这个项目做份开发计划。
say.note: 进入规划模式，先探索代码再提问。

say.text: 先别动手，帮我把这个需求拆成工作计划。
say.note: 触发规划顾问，批准后才产出计划。

say.text: plan before coding，先规划再写代码。
say.note: 进入规划流程，需要你明确确认。

howto.what_en: As the Prometheus planner, Claude explores the codebase read-only, asks only unresolvable forks, then after your explicit okay writes one decision-complete work plan under .omo/ for zero-follow-up execution. It never implements.
howto.when_en: Activates only on an explicit user request for planning before coding, e.g. saying 'ulw-plan', 'make a plan', 'plan before coding', etc. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to make a development plan for this project.
Don't start coding yet; break this down into a work plan.
say_en.note: Triggers planning consultant; waits for your okay.

say_en.text: Plan before coding; I want a step-by-step plan.
say_en.note: Requires explicit approval before writing the plan.
